metadata.description: Prompt enhancement for ZCode: concise rewrites, desktop composer button, preview/apply/undo, slash command and MCP tool.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 提示词增强:精炼改写、输入框 ✦ 按钮、独立预览与回退、斜杠命令与 MCP 工具。

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Prompt enhancer for ZCode: desktop button reuses the current session model (no extra key) with preview/apply/revert; slash command and MCP tool support optional external providers.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过输入框 ✦ 按钮、/enhance-prompt 命令或 enhance_prompt 工具将草稿提示词改写为清晰、精炼、无歧义的指令(精炼优先,少引用具体文件);支持 GLM、OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 提供方,未配置密钥时按同一规则就地增强。
